$note: 第 3 層試點（2026-10-11）：命宮天同天梁坐寅申。條件逐條跟《深造講義》p.16、87–88、309；本質（浪漫／原則）由「性格的骨架」章講，呢度只放會改變結論嘅分支；2026-10-12 起併入六十星系（第 17），細讀擺骨架章。⚠ 引擎冇桃花雜曜、天刑、恩光天貴等，浪漫／原則嘅雜曜條件判斷唔到。

rules.tail: 不過，天同化忌加上羊陀相夾，令這個偏向站不穩。
rules.tailEn: That said, Tian Tong in Obstruction and flanked by Qing Yang and Tuo Luo leaves this lean on unsteady ground.
rules.text: 你在生活情趣和原則紀律之間來回拉扯，兩邊都放不下，也不容易調和。你的天同化忌，兩旁又有擎羊、陀羅相夾，這是這組星最難兩面兼顧的結構。
rules.en: You're pulled back and forth between enjoying life and keeping to principle, unable to let go of either, and the two don't reconcile easily. Your Tian Tong is in Obstruction and flanked by Qing Yang and Tuo Luo, the hardest arrangement of these stars for holding both sides together.

source.quote: 最坏的基本结构，是天同化忌，羊陀夹忌

rules.edit: 原句後半有人格貶語（慳貪鄙吝、自私自利），不用；保留「徘徊」與「最壞結構」。

rules.text: 天同天梁以寅申最平穩；你的盤有吉化或祿存配合，發展平穩，少大風浪。
rules.en: Tian Tong and Tian Liang are steadiest in Yin and Shen; with a favourable transformation or Lu Cun alongside, your path develops steadily, without big storms.

source.quote: 最为平稳，只须见到吉化

rules.edit: 原書「一生平穩發展」，不寫「一生」。

rules.text: 天同見煞忌，好的條件要先經過一段艱難才得到，很少坐享其成。
rules.en: When Tian Tong meets malefics or Obstruction, good conditions come only after a hard stretch, and rarely without effort.

source.quote: 亦必主人先历艰危然后发福

rules.edit: 福取 p.14「經挫折後的安定」之義，不寫成發福的保證。

rules.text: 你的天同化忌有祿存配合，同宮沒有火鈴空劫：靠自己白手掙得到，只是很費精神。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong in Obstruction has Lu Cun alongside and no Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Di Kong or Di Jie in the palace: you can build something from nothing on your own, though it takes a lot out of you.

source.quote: 则主白手生财，但费精神

rules.text: 你的天同化忌雖有祿存配合，同宮卻有煞星：你不容易安於一份工作，時常有變動，要安定下來得多花力氣。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong in Obstruction has Lu Cun alongside, but there's a malefic in the palace: it's hard for you to stay with one line of work, changes come often, and settling takes extra effort.

source.quote: 则表征为不安一业，时生变动

rules.edit: 不寫成讀者必定轉工或財務結果。

rules.text: 同宮再有地空或地劫，你的想法往往不被身邊的人理解，常覺得落單。
rules.en: With Di Kong or Di Jie also in the palace, your ideas are often not understood by those around you, and you often feel left on your own.

source.quote: 其人的思想必不为人理解

rules.edit: 原書「必不為人理解」，讀者版用「往往」：理解與否取決於旁人。

rules.text: 這組星遇上天馬：你的理想會走得比實際快，計劃要落到具體的一步。
rules.en: These stars meet Tian Ma: your ideals run ahead of what is practical, so bring plans down to a concrete next step.

rules.text: 會照的天機或太陰化忌，令你凡事自己盤算、多用心計，別人不容易摸清你的想法。
rules.en: Tian Ji or Tai Yin in Obstruction in the trine palaces makes you work everything out on your own and rely on calculation, so others find it hard to read you.
rules.edit: 原書「權詐百出」不用；保留「機心自用」之義。

basis.quote: 带浪漫色彩，抑或带原则纪律
